description: Energy system models for Finland, 2023 and 2030, incl. power and district heating sectors is a model or code deposit deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Jaakko Hyypiä, Päivi Sikiö (Lappeenranta-Lahti University of Technology). This dataset is used for modeling of Finnish energy system for reference years 2023 and 2030. The system model includes power and district heating sectors. Two different modeling frameworks were used: EnergyPLAN version 16.3 and Calliope version 0.6. Coverage: national (FI); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
